persons.name: Kṛṣṇasaṃhaka
persons.evidence: (vai ki taṃ kṛṣṇa| saṃhakaḥ) prayogamukhyaṃ likhitaṃ pustakaṃ

date.as_written: milite bhavatsare, yukte site kāmatithau viśāṣabhe, bhṛgaur (!) ddine

notes: The colophon text is fragmentary and preserved in verse with several uncertain readings in parentheses. A teacher's name is tentatively restored by the cataloguer as Kamalakṣaṇa (or perhaps Kamalākṣa), whose pupil wrote the manuscript. The scribe's name is tentatively read as Kṛṣṇasaṃhaka (or similar). Kāmatithi corresponds to the 13th tithi (trayodaśī), and viśāṣabha to Viśākhā nakṣatra.
